title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1990-03-29
lineage: Charlie Miller Transfer: Dat > Sony PCM r500 > Tascam DA-3000 > Flac 16/48  Edited & reMastered by Joe Noel Flac 16/48 > Audacity > 16/48 September 27, 2018
source: Ted Mattes Recording: Schoeps CMC4 MK21 (ORTF) > Prolink Oade Modified Grace Preamp > DAT 48k (Panasonic SV-250) Location: Sec b1 Row 20 Seat 8/9

ai_review.summary: Warm audience recording captures a memorable Dark Star with good dynamics despite modest precision.
ai_review.review: The audience‑sourced tape, remastered by Mattes and Miller, delivers an ambient, warm sound that compensates for the lack of pinpoint board clarity. Listeners recall the powerful Dark Star moment, and after 35 years the show still “holds water,” making it a solid addition to the archive.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed five‑star review praises both performance and recording; the other is anticipatory but not negative, leading to a strong overall impression.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, ambient sound with good dynamics; lacks pinpoint precision of a board mix but offers pleasing warmth and spatial depth.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is remembered for its impactful Dark Star moment; reviewers feel the show still resonates strongly after decades.
